name: Weather Core
description: Shared assets for the weather widget family. Bundles the Phosphor icon map, colour/tint helpers, and SVG chart primitives used by weather_now, weather_forecast, weather_hourly, weather_air_quality, weather_pollen_count, weather_wind, sky_moon, and sky_bom_warnings — so the design tokens and icon roles stay consistent across all 32 variant frames.
